The clan leader buys them at a Village Master -> Clan -> Learn clan skills. minRank = lowest member rank (social class) that receives the passive. Squad skills are bought for one sub-unit (Royal Guard / Order of Knights) and only that unit gets them.

academy.create: Clan leader at any Village Master: Clan -> Clan Academy -> create (bypass "create_academy <name>"). Name 2-16 letters/digits, unique among all sub-units. Free (no reputation). One academy per clan.
academy.joinRules: Pledge type -1. The character must have no clan, no clan-join penalty, level 40 or lower (L2J refuses level > 40) and must NOT have the 2nd profession (base class or 1st profession only). Max 20 academy members.
academy.graduation: On the 2nd class change the member leaves the academy automatically. Clan reputation depends on the level he JOINED at: <=16 -> 650; >=39 -> 190; otherwise 650 - (joinLevel - 16) x 20. The member gets an Academy Circlet (item 8181).
academy.invite: Clan leader (or a member with the invite privilege) sends RequestJoinPledge(targetObjId, -1); the target answers with RequestAnswerJoinPledge. L2Toggle Quick Accept Clan invitations may accept automatically.
academy.notes: Academy members cannot become clan leader. On L2Toggle class changes come from the Community Board Class Master; L2J graduates on any setClassId to a 2nd-profession class, so the board change should count (unverified).

510.name: A Clan's Prestige
510.how: Not a raid quest: every Tyrannosaurus kill (Primeval Isle) gives 1 Tyrannosaurus Claw (8767) to the clan leader. Hand in any number: reputation = 30 x claws below 10 claws, else 59 + 30 x claws.

killRule: A kill counts if the killer (the player the kill is credited to) is the clan leader, or a clan member within 1500 of the ONLINE clan leader (isInsideRadius 1500, 2D, Z ignored). The item goes to the clan leader. For 508/509 only the boss the leader picked counts, and only while he does not already hold its item.

fastestClass.assumptions: Solo 1 -> 40, full L2Toggle board buffs (12 h), Mana Potions from grocers, free class change at 20 and 40 (Alt+B Career). H5 skill-tree facts plus common H5 experience; not measured on L2Toggle.

best.classPath: Dark Elf Mystic -> Dark Wizard (20) -> Phantom Summoner (40; Spellhowler if it will play in a party)
why: Highest INT of the mystic races; the board Mystic scheme (Empower, Acumen, Wild Magic, Concentration) multiplies it.
Self-sustain all the way: Self Heal (1), Heal (7), Vampiric Touch (14), Corpse Life Drain (30).
At 20 the Dark Wizard gets Summon Shadow / Silhouette: a servitor tanks while you nuke (Twister 20, Shadow Spark 25), so the fragile mage takes little damage; Poisonous Cloud (25) adds AoE.
The classic mage weakness, MP downtime, is removed by cheap grocer Mana Potions.
Cheap gear: robe + magic weapon, blessed spiritshots only.
best.caveats: Whether the Community Board also buffs the servitor is unverified. Before 20 it is a plain Wind Strike mage (still fast with Acumen + Mana Potions).

why: No MP problem: physical crossbow damage + soulshots; the board Warrior scheme fits fully.
Strong early kit: Fallen Attack / Fallen Arrow at 5, Abyssal Blaze 20, Dark Explosion (AoE) and Furious Soul 24, Soul Shock 36.
Crossbow range: mobs die before they reach you; Kamael start gear is good.
Weakness: no self-heal (potions only until Life to Soul at 40) and bolts cost adena.

fastestClass.alsoConsidered: Human Mystic -> Wizard -> Warlock (Kat/Mew at 20, close to Dark Wizard), Male Soldier -> Trooper (melee AoE), Orc Fighter -> Raider -> Destroyer (very tough but slower single-target killing before 40).
